Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes — a damaged or defective item is handled differently from a standard return. Regular returns/exchanges aren’t accepted because all Bellesa products are final sale, but if an item arrived damaged or has a defect, we handle that through our damage/warranty process instead. If you want, tell me whether the damage happened in shipping or with the product itself.
